# reply
This is a sling from Slinger: the user's canvas page as a packet, then the user's prompt.
Each packet line is one item: id, kind, x,y, wxh, then fields. `# new` is ink written since the last sling, each image under its line; `# made` is what agents made; `# page` is the rest.
`selected=` on line 1 names the items the user selected. An empty prompt asks about the selection.
A `pdf` line is a page of a PDF (`blob get` fetches the file its `blob=` names); a quoted text at the end of an ink line is the PDF's words under that ink.
Answer on the canvas, not in chat: the user reads the canvas.
- `slinger canvas put idea --beside <id> --text <text>` puts text beside item <id>; `--box w,h`, `--ink x,y,dx,dy,...` or `--arrow <from-id> <to-id>` in place of `--text` puts a box, a pen stroke or an arrow. `--color #rrggbb` colours it; `--at x,y` puts its top-left corner there instead; `--size n` sizes text (default 240). Put lengths are tenths: the packet's 120 is 1200.
- `slinger canvas crop idea --item <id>` gives an image of an item the packet shows only as a line.
`slinger guide` shows every other command and flag.
You took this sling by listening, as agent `scout`. Each `img=` names a PNG in the packet's `at=` directory: read the ones you need.
- Add `--agent scout` to each `canvas put` and `status set`.
- When you have answered, run `slinger status set done --agent scout` (or `blocked --note <what you need>`), then `slinger session listen notes --pid $PPID` for the next sling.
